statusDetail: Atomic audit completed across seven representative public routes. Authenticated tipping, completed registration, paid Profipaket purchase, and destructive account actions were not exercised because they require credentials, payment, or side effects.

page.framework: Server-rendered MPA with ES modules and jQuery
page.notes: Public sports prediction service with app-like game, membership, and account flows. The route set covers landing, listing, detail, creation, login, help, and recovery templates.

paths.description: Public landing page and primary start-game call to action; represents global chrome and marketing entry.

findings.summary: System dark mode leaves the page light
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot remains white and the preference probe reports colorScheme "normal" with dark media matching.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, control, and image colors.

findings.summary: Route changes do not use cross-document View Transitions
findings.evidence: DOM and platform probes found no authored transition names beyond the browser default and no cross-document transition rule across this MPA.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values for shared route chrome, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long pages use static chrome without scroll-state guidance
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshots of the long open-games and help pages show fixed top chrome but no progress, shrink, or other scroll-position cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a lightweight progress affordance on long listings and help indexes.

findings.summary: The competition picker is not exposed as a native select
findings.evidence: The create-game UI visibly presents a competition dropdown, while the DOM probe reports zero select, dialog, details, or popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native select with branded styling, or the customizable select pattern with a semantic fallback.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior relies on viewport styling only
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero @container rules even though cards, game rows, forms, and header components recur at different widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type to reusable regions and adapt their children with size container queries where reuse demands it.

findings.summary: Some touch targets are below the recommended target size
findings.evidence: The focus/geometry probe measured footer controls such as DE at roughly 34 by 33 CSS pixels, while primary tiles are 50 by 50.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase compact footer links to at least a 44 by 44 CSS pixel activation area without crowding the text.

findings.summary: Empty form submission gives no visible or focused recovery state
findings.evidence: After activating the create-game submit button with all fields empty, the screenshot stayed unchanged, the probe found no alert or invalid field, and focus fell to body.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after submission, mark invalid controls, move focus to a summary or first error, and provide an actionable message.

findings.summary: Resource delivery leaves avoidable render-blocking and cache work
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports about 300 ms render-blocking savings, 110 ms font-display savings, and 49 KiB cache savings; the HAR confirms parser-discovered CSS and scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten critical chains, set font-display, review cache lifetimes, and prioritize only the actual LCP resource.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable CSS and legacy JavaScript
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 20 KiB unused CSS and 35 KiB legacy JavaScript on the home route.
findings.suggestedFix: Split route CSS and stop transpiling features already supported by the target Baseline.

findings.summary: Several icon links have no accessible name
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails link-name; the DOM probe lists the login icon, logo wrapper, and at least one game image link as unnamed controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each icon-only link a concise accessible name and ensure linked images contribute an appropriate name.

findings.summary: Foreground and background colors fail WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.65 and specifically failed the color-contrast audit on the home page.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust the failing foreground/background token pairs to meet WCAG AA in every state.

findings.summary: Pages lack a main landmark
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails landmark-one-main and the DOM probes report main:false on home, create, login, listing, and game templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap each page primary content in main and retain one logical h1 and visible focus treatment.

findings.summary: The viewport disables pinch zoom
findings.evidence: The live viewport meta is width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no; Lighthouse fails meta-viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and the restrictive maximum-scale so users can zoom to at least 200 percent.

findings.summary: Image dimensions and delivery are not consistently sound
findings.evidence: The image primitive finds two images without full dimensions and 12 displayed at less than half their intrinsic width; Lighthouse flags unsized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width and height on every img and serve responsive candidates with srcset and sizes.

findings.summary: The home page is not eligible for back-forward cache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports one BFCache failure reason, reducing instant back-navigation quality.
findings.suggestedFix: Inspect the reported BFCache blocker and remove unload or other disqualifying behavior.

findings.summary: Some representative pages omit a meta description
findings.evidence: Discoverability evidence for the help route reports metaDescriptionPresentInRaw:null although its title and h1 are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a unique, concise description to help and other index templates.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are incomplete
findings.evidence: The platform probe finds no canonical URL and /sitemap.xml returns a structured 404; robots.txt does not advertise a sitemap.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish canonical links per public template and a sitemap, then reference it from robots.txt.

findings.summary: Rich entity metadata stops at generic Open Graph tags
findings.evidence: The home probe finds generic Open Graph tags but no JSON-LD for the organization or app, and the title/description are less specific than visible content.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization or SoftwareApplication JSON-LD and route-specific social metadata.

findings.summary: Content Security Policy is missing
findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirms HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff, and X-Frame-Options, but reports no Content-Security-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce or hash based CSP, starting in report-only mode, then enforce it after removing violations.

findings.summary: Authentication offers passwords without a passkey path
findings.evidence: The login template exposes only email and password fields with no visible passkey option or WebAuthn capability in the inspected flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside the existing recovery path.

findings.summary: Referrer and Permissions policies are absent
findings.evidence: The headers primitive reports missing Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, though HSTS and clickjacking protection are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter referrer policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The app manifest is incomplete and no service worker controls the page
findings.evidence: manifest.json has icons, theme_color, and display but no start_url; the platform probe reports serviceWorkerController:false.
findings.suggestedFix: Complete the manifest and add an offline fallback service worker for the app shell and recovery page.

findings.summary: Localized variants rely on physical CSS directions
findings.evidence: The home page advertises 12 hreflang variants, but the CSS probe counted 88 physical left/right rules and zero logical-property rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Migrate layout spacing and positioning to inline/block logical properties and verify an RTL locale.

findings.summary: Form validation does not communicate errors humanely
findings.evidence: Empty create-game and login submissions produced no alert, aria-invalid state, focused error, or visible feedback in the captured state.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after interaction, use :user-invalid, associate field messages, and announce a summary with aria-live.

findings.summary: Account creation fields omit autocomplete tokens
findings.evidence: The create-game probe shows empty autocomplete values for email and password, while the login template correctly uses username and current-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Add email and new-password autocomplete tokens to account-creation controls.

findings.summary: Game logos are oversized legacy PNGs
findings.evidence: The image audit finds 15 legacy-format images, 12 oversized, no modern formats, and missing responsive sources; HAR attributes 384 KiB to images.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF or WebP variants at the 48 to 50 CSS pixel display sizes and use srcset/sizes.
